subject_info.textbooks: 『Go Global: English for Global Business』（成美堂）

goal: The objective of this course is to develop the ability to collaborate and engage in meaningful conversations or discussions in English with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds in pursuit of shared problem-solving. In addition, students will cultivate the skills necessary to articulate their own perspectives clearly in English, as globally minded engineers, on the complex issues confronting contemporary society.

educational_methods:
**概要:**

          This course is designed with the expectation that students will engage in overseas internships or interact with international researchers and engineers. It focuses primarily on improving English speaking and listening skills in terms of "English for global business." 
1. Acquisition of essential vocabulary and expressions for "English for Global Business."
2. Practical application in conversation of the essential vocabulary and expressions for "English for Global Business."
3. Development of a proactive attitude toward speaking English with the goal of becoming "global-engineers" in the near future.

      **授業の進め方・方法:**

          This course will take a practical, hands-on approach to help students acquire "English for global business." Each class will begin with a "small talk" activity in pairs or groups on a variety of topics. Next, students will review the textbook topic and practice key expressions through conversation exercises. At the end of each class, students will submit a reaction paper to reflect on what they have learned. In addition, participation in out-of-class activities will be assigned.

      **注意点:**

          Students are expected to actively participate in each class. Don’t hesitate to make mistakes when speaking English. To make the most of this once-a-week opportunity to use English, both pre- and post-class study are essential. This out-of-class learning will be counted as part of the coursework and be reflected in your final grade. Furthermore, to provide instruction suited to each student’s proficiency level, the course will be divided into two classes based on TOEIC scores.
